decisions.reason: Assigning Business as Article 3's category does not change the required author identity, photo, source, or placement after the category label.
The category mapping does not alter the rules for requesting images or using elements to break up excessive text.
The category assigned to Article 3 does not affect the required shape or size of author photos.
Article 3's Business category mapping does not change the separate color restriction for the Dorian Vale article or the cover.
Specifying Article 3's category does not change the Civic Lantern website as the source of article content.
The article-specific category mapping does not modify the magazine's polished, modern, brand-aligned visual style.
The category mapping does not alter the interactive digital flipbook PDF deliverable.
Assigning a category to Article 3 does not change the requirement to enhance image quality when necessary.
The Article 3 category mapping does not change the attributes or deferred lifecycle of the print-ready output.
